description: A PHP trait named IndexingLockFileTrait that provides methods to read, write, and manage lock files for indexing tasks in SuiteCRM. It includes functions to read timestamps, check file accessibility, generate lock file paths, and format time intervals.

methods.name: readLockFile
methods.description: Reads the lock file, returning a Carbon timestamp or false if not found or unreadable.

methods.name: getLockFile
methods.description: Generates the lock file name based on the class name.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists and is readable.

methods.name: writeLockFile
methods.description: Writes the current timestamp to the lock file.

methods.name: formatInterval
methods.description: Converts a number of seconds into a human-readable interval string.
